senses.def: A region in the Mexican state of Yucatán.
A Maya architectural style prevalent in that region.
A type of sharp, pointed knife of Nordic heritage, with a short blade and flat back; normally worn in a sheath on the waist, and used for woodcrafts or as a hunting knife.
Any of a family of marine sponge metabolites isolated mainly from the orders Verongida and Dictyoceratida.
